name: assetpanda/roi-hero
title: AP Roi Hero
description: ROI calculator page hero (Figma 'Pricing - New Jun 11 2026 - Opt 1', node 7169:88796, restyled per QA 2026-10-29): eyebrow, headline and lede on the white page beside a card holding the HubSpot quote form, drawn like the Get a Demo booking form (demo-booking's .ap-dw-* card, white floating-label fields, the indigo-to-green button, an optional compliance badge row) with no testimonial column. The form is the live A/B-tested /new-pricing/ quote form: behaviour.js loads HubSpot's v2 embed into the labelled mount, fills HubSpot's own labels from form_placeholders (they float on focus / value / autofill), applies the submit label and the redirect, and keeps ZoomInfo 'enrich' fields hidden until enrichment cannot fill them (same rules as pricing-hero). Reserves the form's height while it loads (no layout shift) and shows a contact line if HubSpot is blocked. Pairs with pricing-calculator variant 2026 (the gradient splash and glass card). This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
